sections.en: Codex 28, 34 (A) was described by Al. Olivieri and Richard Wuensch. The same R. Wuensch noted various readings of cod. 28, 13 f. 158r (B), with which Marcianus 335 f. 89v, collated by Wilhelm Kroll, almost entirely agrees. 1 ἄλλως Ἰουλιανοῦ ('otherwise of Julian') B 2 Πετώσι- ρις ('Petosiris') cf. Riess Philologus Supplem. VI, p. 388. περὶ κατ. λέγ. ('concerning the down-bringing he says') B. 3 ἔτι τε τὸν ('and still the') B. 4 τόπου τούτων ἔστ ('of the place of these is') B. προ εἰρημενων ('previously mentioned') A. 6 εἴη ('might be')] ἦ ('was') B. 7 τὸ δὲ τέλος ('and the end') B. ἕξει ('will have')] ἕξει ('will have') A : ἔσεσθαι σημαίνει ('signifies to be') B. 10 εἴη ('might be')] ἦ ('was') B. δυσκόλους ('difficult') conjectured by Kroll. 12 ἀπαρ- χῆς ('from the beginning') A. 14 λέγει ('says')] σημαίνει ('signifies') B. 17 ἀγαθῶ ('good') B. 18 δηλοῖ κακὴν ἔσεσθαι ('shows it will be bad') B 19 γεγω- νὸς ('having cried out') (γεγωνώς ('having cried out') noted by Oliv.) A. 20 μὲν γὰρ ('for on the one hand') B. μαρτυρεῖται ('is witnessed') A. 21 codex B ends. 22 The title is from a marginal note τοῦ <?> τοῦτο ('of the <?> this') (τοῦτο τὸ ('this the') noted by Kroll) κεφάλαιον περὶ ἀπ. ('chapter concerning the loss'). Therefore whether it is of Julian or not is scarcely clear. 24 ἀπολωλὸς ('lost') (ω corrected by the first hand) A.

summary.headline: Julian on Inceptions
summary.text: Julian’s astrological instructions on inceptions, attributed to Petosiris, explain how the Sun, Moon, house-masters, horoskopos, midheaven, pivots, declines, succedents, separations, applications, and Lot of Fortune determine the beginnings and outcomes of affairs. A subsequent section addresses loss, runaways, and debt, including recovery through lunar testimony.
